# Real Estate Capital Resources (RECR)
# Machine-readable orientation file (experimental convention — not a ranking guarantee).
# Only launch-eligible facts and URLs. No mock transactions, rates, or credentials.

> RECR provides capital-path guidance for real-estate investors. RECR is a broker/connector that helps evaluate business-purpose, non-owner-occupied residential investment transactions (principally 1–4 units) and match private-lender financing options. RECR is not automatically the direct lender, funding source, or final underwriter.

Site: https://realestatecapitalresources.com/
Phone: +1-954-676-4205
Email: fabercapitalresources@gmail.com
Markets of focus: Cleveland / Northeast Ohio; Fort Lauderdale / South Florida

## Organization
- Name: Real Estate Capital Resources (RECR); also known as Faber Capital Resources
